lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters organized in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, concentrated between the medial ridge and the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like matrix of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features exhibiting sharp vertical intensity gradients (high luminance above, shadow below) running parallel across the upper third of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of discrete high-luminance blobs visible within the dark macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced caustic network patterns resulting from surface light refraction projected across the dorsal-lateral surface of the specimen.
